newsitem.title: FINLAND: NOKIA WINS $80 MLN GSM EXPANSION IN CHINA.
newsitem.headline: NOKIA WINS $80 MLN GSM EXPANSION IN CHINA.

text.p: Finnish telecoms group Nokia Oy said on Thursday it had signed agreements for the third phase expansion of a GSM network operated by Zhejiang Post and Telecommunications Administration in China.
"The total contract value is approximately $80 million and deliveries are due to begin in ther near future," Nokia said in a statement.
Deliveries would include mobile switching centres and home location registers, base stations and base station controllers and a network management system, it said.
After the expansion, the GSM (Global System for Mobile Communications) network would have the capacity to accommodate more than one million subscribers, Nokia said.
